Bump toml from 0.8 to 0.9 (#180)

The single call site in sailfish-compiler/src/config.rs
(toml::from_str) is stable across the 0.8 to 0.9 transition.
No source changes required.

The workspace lockfile previously carried both toml 0.8.23 (used
by sailfish-compiler) and toml 0.9.7 (pulled in by another
dependency path). After the bump, only the 0.9 stack remains,
so the net lockfile delta is a 61-line reduction.

Verified:
  cargo build
  cargo test     (1 passed, 0 failed)

Pre-existing clippy and fmt issues on master are reproducible on
vanilla master and unrelated to this change.

BugFix Pre-Merge

Fix/upper filter escaping (#195)

* fix: apply uppercase without rewriting HTML escapes

`Upper::render_escaped` uppercased escaped output wholesale, so
Sailfish's HTML escape sequences were rewritten. For example,
`<%= "&" | upper %>` rendered `&` instead of `&`.

Render through the wrapped value's escaped path into a temporary
buffer, then uppercase text while preserving sequences from the shared
escaper table. This retains custom `Render` behavior and filter
composition while keeping the destination unchanged on rendering
errors.

* test: treat near-miss escape sequences as plain text in upper
Latest Release!
Pre-release update commit.

fix: Preserve HTML escapes in lower filter (#198)

`Lower::render_escaped` lowercased the escaped output in place. That
worked only because the five sequences Sailfish emits are already
lowercase. It also left partial output behind when the wrapped value
failed to render, and indexed `b.as_str()[old_len..]` directly, which
panics if a custom renderer shrinks the buffer instead of returning
`RenderError::BufSize`.

Render through the wrapped value's escaped path into a temporary
buffer, then lowercase text while preserving the sequences from the
escaper table, mirroring the `upper` filter since #195.

Also write ASCII runs in bulk and fall back to per-char case mapping
only for non-ASCII input, and move the entity prefix lookup into
`escape::escaped_entity_len` so `filter` no longer reads the escape
table directly. Entity lengths are derived from the table, so the
lookup cannot drift out of sync with it.

Add unit tests for the lookup, escaped-path tests for both filters,
and integration cases in filter2. Update the changelog.
Pre-Merge Commit

fix: escape JSON output for embedding in script elements (#199)

Encode <, >, &, apostrophes, U+2028, and U+2029 as JSON Unicode
escapes in the unescaped json filter. This prevents serialized
strings from closing an enclosing script element while preserving
decoded JSON values.

Escape directly in the serialization writer using a byte lookup
table, without an intermediate buffer or additional dependencies.
Preserve the HTML-escaped path and partial-output behavior on
serialization errors.

Add roundtrip, Unicode, fragmented serialization, error propagation,
and template integration tests. Document supported output contexts
and note the serialized-text change in the changelog.
